description: Contagion Intelligence — simulates how a macro or financial shock spreads through 30 nodes across 6 domains using an epidemiological R-value model. Returns system R trajectory, per-epoch spread map, superspreader nodes, containment forecast, and AI briefing. R < 1.0 = self-limiting; R ≥ 1.0 = expanding. Call with listNodes:true first to discover valid origin IDs.

listNodes.description: If true, returns all valid origin node IDs instead of running a simulation.

origin.description: Origin node ID. Call intelligence.contagion with listNodes:true to discover valid IDs.

name: intelligence.contagion
